chat_messages.speaker: Game Master
chat_messages.message: You see Eldric stand motionless, his gaze fixed on some unseen point, then Mimi follows suit, her hands resting at her sides. Gribbles Rindsworth shifts his weight but makes no move, the silence stretching as the party holds their breath. As the next round begins, Marta the Scholar steps forward, her eyes scanning the room with renewed focus.

chat_messages.speaker: Game Master
chat_messages.message: You stand in the dim chamber, watching Eldric pause mid-step, his hand hovering near his blade before he simply waits. You follow his lead, holding your breath and listening for any sound beyond the flickering torchlight. Gribbles shifts his weight but likewise stays still, and the silence stretches until Marta the Scholar finally stirs, her robes rustling as she prepares to act.

chat_messages.speaker: Game Master
chat_messages.message: You watch as Eldric and Mimi both hold their positions, the silence in the room stretching taut. You decide to follow their lead, waiting without making a move as the seconds tick by. As a new round begins, you see Marta the Scholar stir, her turn now upon her.

chat_messages.speaker: Game Master
chat_messages.message: You watch as Eldric and then Mimi stand motionless, each seemingly lost in thought or waiting for something unseen. Gribbles Rindsworth follows suit, his turn passing without a sound or gesture. As the silence stretches into a new round, you feel the weight of the moment pressing on you, your own turn now beginning in this strange, suspended tableau.

chat_messages.speaker: Game Master
chat_messages.message: You stand still, watching the dust motes settle in the dim light as Mimi and Gribbles Rindsworth also hold their positions, the silence stretching. A full minute passes with no one moving, the only sound the faint drip of water somewhere in the stone. Then, you notice Marta the Scholar stirs, her robes rustling as she begins her own turn.
